summary: Tested the public deployment end to end. Backend regression: 11/13 passed; product, auth, config, storage, search, sort and delete flows work, with two API-contract failures. Frontend catalog/admin/cart/checkout/QR flows passed on desktop and mobile; only an accessibility console warning was found.

critical.issue: With Instagram credentials empty, a successful create response returns instagram_status='pending' instead of the required 'skipped'. GET shortly afterward shows 'skipped', so the POST response is stale/inconsistent with persisted state.

minor.issue: Omitting the multipart name field returns FastAPI's default 422 validation response instead of the required 400 validation response/message. A blank supplied name correctly returns 400.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the cart logs Radix accessibility warnings that DialogContent is missing a Description/aria-describedby.

action_items: Make POST /api/products return instagram_status='skipped' immediately when Instagram credentials are absent, matching persisted state and the Admin label.
Normalize missing required multipart fields such as name to the specified 400 response with a validation message.
Add an accessible Sheet/Dialog description to CartDrawer to remove the Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: create_product and download_file call synchronous requests-based object-storage helpers directly inside async routes; move these calls to an async HTTP client or a threadpool to avoid blocking the FastAPI event loop.
ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET have hardcoded defaults (including dev-secret). Required credentials/secrets should come only from environment variables and fail fast if missing.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ products across API and UI tests; all were deleted and GET /api/products was verified empty afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run backend_test.py after product-create response/status fixes. Full UI E2E passed for login validation, create/delete, Instagram No configurado label, search/sort/badges (including agotado), cart qty/remove/totals, checkout confirmation/delivery, WhatsApp target, QR canvas/download, and mobile overflow.
rca_of_the_issue: The missing-name request is rejected by FastAPI before route code because name is declared Form(...), yielding 422. The Instagram state mismatch occurs because Product defaults to pending and that object is returned before the background publish/skip task updates MongoDB to skipped.
